name: Gregor Schmidt
headline: Investment Director at Egeria | Private Equity
summary:
I am an Investment Director at Egeria, a leading investment company active in the Netherlands (Amsterdam), Germany (Munich), and the US (Boston) that focuses on medium-sized companies with EBITDA of €10M-€50M. Prior to joining Egeria, I was a management consultant at Bain & Company.

I hold a Master's degree in Management & Technology from the Technical University of Munich (TUM), where I specialized in Finance and Mechanical Engineering. Prior to that, I obtained a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from WHU.

company.name: Egeria
company.description:
We are Egeria: an independent investment company active in three asset classes, aimed at long-term value growth through entrepreneurial partnerships:

-	Private Equity: we invest in healthy businesses in the Benelux- and DACH-region with an enterprise value of up to €350 million with the underlying principle that management is co-owner. We operate out of our offices in Amsterdam (NL) and Munich (DE). 
-	Real Estate: we invest in commercial and residential real estate in Germany, the Netherlands and the US and we (re)develop real estate projects in the Netherlands. 
-	Listed Investments: we invest in listed companies by taking minority interests and acting as an active partner to management and other shareholders. 

We are always looking for both talented professionals to strengthen our team as well as companies and real estate projects in which to invest. 
Please take a look at our website and reach out to us: www.egeriagroup.com.
